Dock 2 remains closed until I authorize a controlled reopening with the required safety controls in place. In the meantime, the warehouse must continue processing outbound orders from the other docks. Per our incident-response routine, I need current findings from maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing before I can authorize reopening. Once each area has reported, I can settle the reopening plan immediately. Let's get started. Who would like to report first?
